acceptanceCriteria: The style model distinguishes five-image recurrence from per-image subject, wording, palette choice, pose, crop, objects, and concrete layout.
Every training, validation, and test judge record contains per-reference style losses for all five truth images and aggregates each style component by median.
Every feedback item remains traceable and passes its independent semantic-region, typography, or provenance gate.
Every generation-provenance-v2 record hashes the immutable base prompt, exact effective prompt bytes sent to the tool, and canonical optional-instruction JSON separately.
Every generation receives exactly one source_reference image and contains no truth-set path, member hash, set hash, or truth/style role.
The final prompt is self-contained text, preserves arbitrary source identity and content, and requires no target or style-reference image at generation time.
Frozen validation and the fresh garden-workbench one-shot test prove baseline transfer, optional composition, exact-text adherence, and absence of unrequested text.
constraints: Use exact-path allowlisted reads only before validation; do not inventory target, validation, test, or prior-train directories.
Use repository-relative paths in persisted artifacts.
Use the built-in image generation tool.
Treat train-0011 evidence as research evidence, not as unquestioned truth.
Do not modify prior iteration evidence or the existing truth manifest.
All five target/style truth images are analysis-and-judge-only and forbidden as generation inputs.
Do not open validationManifest before validate-transferability.
Do not open sealedTestManifest before audit-generalization.
Do not compare style-inversion-v3-ensemble-v1 losses numerically with singleton style-inversion-v3 or earlier versions, and do not update the singleton-regime best.json without recalibration.
requestedWork: Re-run prompt inversion with the immutable primary truth plus four additional images generated from the same original hidden prompt. Infer only visual language recurring across the five-image truth set, use train-0011 evidence to retain source-relative semantic-region and exact-text policies, and correct its effective-prompt provenance defects. Keep all truth images analysis-and-judge-only and validate the frozen prompt on a fresh one-shot source.
